description: FastTrack is not enabled. FastTrack can significantly improve routing performance by bypassing the connection tracking for established connections.
recommendation: Enable FastTrack in /ip firewall filter by adding action=fasttrack-connection for established,related connections.

description: No DNS servers are explicitly configured. The router will use DNS servers obtained from ISP via DHCP.
recommendation: Consider setting static DNS servers in /ip dns for reliability.

description: No password protection configured for the router.
recommendation: Set a strong admin password using /user set admin password=<strong-password>.
Configure automatic backups using /system backup save or export configuration regularly.

description: DHCP server is configured without static DHCP mappings for known devices.
recommendation: Add static DHCP mappings in /ip dhcp-server lease for devices that need fixed IP addresses.
